## Why This Is Asked
A real-world, beginner-friendly scenario where CKNE affects per-tenant notebook resource allocation in a shared service.

- CKNE-driven budgets: translate to CPU/memory quotas per tenant

- Payload: minimal notebook spec with owner, CKNE, resources

```javascript
function computeBudget(ckne, base) {
  const premium = Math.max(0, 1 - ckne);
  return {
    cpu: base.cpu * (1 + premium),
    mem: base.mem * (1 + premium)
  };
}
```
